info.title: EnvPlane API
info.description: Control plane API for EnvPlane environments, projects, products, settings and webhook intake. Legacy product identifiers remain compatibility aliases during the versioned migration window.

x-branding.wireCompatibility: JSON field names, enum values, paths and authentication schemes are stable in v1
x-branding.deprecationPolicy: Legacy machine identifiers are read-only compatibility aliases and are removed only in a future major version.

apiToken.name: Authorization
apiToken.description: Bearer <token> with optional ENVPLANE_API_READ_TOKEN / ENVPLANE_API_WRITE_TOKEN; ENVPLANE_* names remain accepted during migration

agentAuthToken.description: Bearer agentAuthToken returned by POST /api/v1/agents/register. The one-time bootstrap token is only valid for the initial registration exchange and must not be sent to heartbeat or resource scan endpoints.

runnerAuthToken.description: Bearer runnerAuthToken returned by POST /api/v1/runners/register. The one-time bootstrap token is only valid for the initial registration exchange and must not be sent to heartbeat endpoints.

projectConfigToken.description: Bearer projectConfigToken from runner deployment instructions. This token is bound to runner identity, one-time use, and must be sent only in the Authorization header.

FirstRunProgress.description: Installation-scoped resumable onboarding progress. This safe read model contains no credentials, personal data, or user-entered configuration.

FirstRunSupportBundle.description: Offline-safe first-run diagnostics. It contains no credentials, repository names, resource manifests, or personal data.

CurrentClusterPreflight.description: Safe current-cluster discovery metadata. It excludes secrets, kubeconfig data, and workload specifications.

managedClusterId.description: Chart-configured logical cluster ID eligible for current-cluster reconciliation, or empty when disabled.

managedProjectId.description: Chart-configured project ID eligible for current-cluster reconciliation, or empty when disabled.

immutable_digest.description: Immutable sha256 digest used for deployable component images.

AuthenticationSettings.description: Installation-wide safe read model for interactive browser authentication. It never contains clientSecret.

AuthenticationProviderSettings.description: Safe provider metadata. callbackUrl is derived from the canonical public control-plane URL and is not writable.

AuthenticationSettingsCommand.description: Write-only command. clientSecret is never returned by AuthenticationSettings.

InitialAuthenticationCommand.description: Write-only initial setup command. clientSecret is accepted but is never returned.

ActivationCodeCommand.description: Write-only activation command. activationCode is never returned by any API read model.

sameCluster.description: Safe management-cluster target metadata. It never includes Kubernetes, OAuth, Agent, or Runner credentials.

BootstrapSessionStep.description: Versioned bootstrap wizard step. Zero is the initial step and eight is compiled.

AIAgentGrant.description: Opaque, non-exportable capability record. The grant ID is only a server-side lookup handle and is not a credential.
